I'd put this around 0.60-0.65. Given conservative society and church opposition, some social friction is expected.

The 2024 state direction is current and concerning. I'd say ~0.60. It sits below the 0.65 anchors because of active state hostility (2024 policy direction) and conservative climate with thin recourse, but above 0.55 because no documented visitor-facing targeting or universal exposure.
